headline: Board to discuss artwork donation, AI meeting notes, City Council-approved PML donation, and bylaws update.
summary: The Pollard Memorial Library Board of Trustees will discuss a donation of artwork, AI meeting notes, the October Library Legislative Breakfast, a donation for the PML approved by City Council, and a continued bylaws update. The board will also receive updates on the Strategic Plan Work Groups and committee, director, and liaison reports.
items: October Library Legislative Breakfast – Lowell, MA
Donation for the PML approved by City Council
Director's Report (building issues, personnel, programming highlights, and budget)
Liaisons' Reports (PML Foundation and Friends of the PML)
location: Pollard Memorial Library, Director's Office – 2nd Floor, 401 Merrimack St., Lowell, MA 01852 and via Zoom

Board of Trustees
NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING
Organization: Pollard Memorial Library Board of Trustees
Date:  Wednesday – October 14, 2026 - Time:  5:30 p.m.
Location:  Pollard Memorial Library   401 Merrimack St.   Lowell, MA 01852
    Director’s Office – 2nd Floor and via Zoom
On March 28, 2025, Governor Healey signed An Act Extending Certain COVID-19 Measures Adopted
During the State of Emergency for temporary provisions pertaining to the Open Meeting Law to June
30, 2027. Specifically, this further extension allows public bodies to continue holding meetings
remotely without a quorum of the public body physically present at a meeting location, and to provide
"adequate, alternative" access to remote meetings. The language does not make any substantive
changes to the Open Meeting Law other than extending the expiration date of the temporary
provisions regarding remote meetings from March 31, 2025 to June 30, 2027.
Members of the public wishing to attend the meeting and/or speak regarding a specific agenda item
should email the Library Director at bcooley@Lowellma.gov indicating your name and on which
agenda item(s) you would like to speak. Since the meeting is hybrid, you may attend in-person at the
Library or online. If the meeting is hybrid and you do not wish to attend in-person, you will be sent
the access information needed to join the meeting. If you do not have email access, you can also call
978-674-1548 for the meeting information.
